name: Gate

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: an unoccupied space you can see

summary: Open a portal 5 to 20 feet across to a place on another plane, or name a creature there to pull it through.
text: Only the portal's front side carries travellers across, and deities can block it in their domains. A creature you name by its true name is drawn to the nearest free space on your side, free to act as it chooses.
